title: Settings
llmDesc: Manage LLM backends, models and instances
aboutDesc1: NeoMind is an intelligent AI agent platform running on edge devices, supporting multi-model LLM, event-driven architecture, device management, rule engine and workflow orchestration.
aboutDesc2: Through a plug-in architecture, NeoMind can flexibly expand functionality, supporting MQTT, Webhook and other device adapters to achieve true intelligent edge computing.
dataPersistenceDesc: Time-series data, vector search, decision storage
displayTimeZoneDesc: Choose how time is displayed in the UI
preferencesInfo: Preferences are saved in browser local storage
globalTimezoneDesc: System-wide timezone for agent scheduling and time references
systemTimezoneDesc: Used for cron scheduling and time calculations
schedulingTimezoneDesc: Used for Agent cron scheduling and time calculations
updateAvailableDesc: A new version of NeoMind is available. Would you like to update now?
downloadingUpdateDesc: Please wait while the update is being downloaded.
installingUpdateDesc: Please wait while the update is being installed.
updateReadyDesc: The update has been downloaded and installed. Please relaunch the application to complete the update.
updateAvailableWithVersion: Version {{version}} of NeoMind is available. Would you like to update now?
alreadyUpToDate: You are already running the latest version of NeoMind.
diagnosticDataDesc: Download a ZIP archive of all server log files for troubleshooting and support.
dataManagementDesc: Configure telemetry data retention and cleanup policies
defaultRetentionDesc: Retention period for numeric metrics (temperature, humidity, etc.)
imageRetentionDesc: Retention period for image and binary data from camera devices

broker.settingsDescription: Configure the built-in MQTT broker for device connections
broker.authDescription: Require username/password for external device connections
broker.noCredentials: No credentials configured. Add a user to enable authentication.
broker.tlsDescription: Encrypt MQTT connections with TLS certificates
broker.restartWarning: Port/TLS/auth changes require server restart to take effect
broker.restartRequired: Auth, port or TLS settings changed. Please restart the server to apply changes
broker.fullRestartRequired: Configuration saved. Please restart the server to apply changes.
broker.autoGenerateDescription: Create self-signed certificates with one click
broker.autoGenerateInfo: Generates a self-signed CA certificate and a server certificate signed by it. The CA certificate can be downloaded and distributed to IoT devices.
broker.caCertDownloadSuccess: Distribute to IoT devices for TLS connections
broker.noCertsDescription: No certificates configured. Choose setup method:
broker.autoDiscoveryDescription: Internal broker automatically discovers devices publishing to any topic
broker.autoDiscoveryHint: Discovered devices appear in the Pending Devices tab for review and onboarding.

agentDefaultsDesc: Agent execution behavior — applies to the next run
maxRoundsDesc: Maximum tool-call rounds per agent execution
toolConcurrencyDesc: Parallel tool executions within a round
defaultThinkingDesc: Override for thinking-enabled models (auto = backend default)
appliesNextRun: Applies to the next agent execution
deviceDefaultsDesc: IoT device behavior — offline detection and auto-onboarding
defaultOfflineTimeoutDesc: Seconds before a silent device is marked offline
autoOnboardEnabledDesc: Automatically create draft devices for unknown MQTT clients (restart to apply)

im.title: Messaging Bridges
im.description: Connect NeoMind to chat platforms so agents can talk to users on IM.
im.addBridgeDesc: Configure a bot token issued by @BotFather.
im.botTokenHelp: Create a bot via Telegram @BotFather and paste its token here.
im.apiBaseHelp: Optional. Override the Telegram Bot API root (e.g. for a self-hosted instance).
im.detailDesc: Generate invites to bind chats, and manage the allowlist.
im.noBridgesDesc: Add a Telegram bot to let agents reply on a chat platform.
im.confirmDelete: This disconnects the bot and revokes pending invites. Continue?
im.invitesDesc: Each invite links one chat to this bridge.
im.scanToConnect: Scan or open the link to connect this chat.
im.deepLinkUnavailable: Deep link is unavailable until the bot is identified.
im.noInvitesDesc: Generate an invite to bind a chat.
im.confirmRevoke: Revoke this invite? A chat that already used it stays connected.
im.allowlistDesc: Chats bound through invites. Remove a chat to disconnect it.
im.noAllowlistDesc: Chats that connect via an invite will appear here.
im.confirmRemove: Remove this chat from the allowlist? The chat will be disconnected.
